description: Tracés du réseau de transport ferré d'Ile-de-France is a dataset listed in Île-de-France Mobilités open data, an open data portal of a public transport authority, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Description linéaire du réseau ferré d’Ile-de-France, avec mise en avant des lignes de Transport en Commun subventionnées par Ile-de-France Mobilités. Généalogie Les sources de cette donnée sont les éléments transmis par les transporteurs, ainsi que la BD TOPO de l'IGN et la photo aérienne pour les tronçons non souterrains. Coverage: France (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal files it under Lignes. Its keywords are Réseau ferré, Plateforme numérique, Opérateur de transport, Collectivité. The portal shows 2026-07-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-idfm-open-data-portal.
